prompt: Image 1 is a flat colour map seen from the game's isometric camera. Earth #6E5941, dark earth #554232, foliage #4C7A3E, moss #435A36, ochre #C8965E, light #DEC28B, slate shadow #2E3552. The picture fills the whole frame from edge to edge. No text, no signature.
